d.ko: The evil organization Fakker has been terrorizing the residents of the city at night, abducting people left and right. One woman stands against them: Magical Valkyrie Frostia. One day, she saves another woman with the potential to transform and their fate may be changed forever...
d.en: The evil organization Fakker has been terrorizing the residents of the city at night, abducting people left and right. One woman stands against them: Magical Valkyrie Frostia. One day, she saves another woman with the potential to transform and their fate may be changed forever...
d.zh: 邪恶组织哈梅尔达每晚都会在城市诱拐女性。一个少女站了出来对抗他们，那就是魔法斗姬芙罗缇亚。某天，她救下了一位有着魔法斗姬潜力的少女，她们的命运都将因此而改变……
